A sharper way to renovate

The look of a bespoke kitchen. A smarter path.

Renofy RTA pairs refined door profiles and considered finishes with a full-access cabinet system. You get the clean lines, storage and soft-close function a modern kitchen deserves—without the longer runway of a fully custom build.

More usable spaceNo face frame means wider cabinet access.
Quiet by design6-way adjustable soft-close hinges.
Built your wayPlywood or particle-board box options.
Made to fitA full family of base, wall and tall cabinets.

Frameless Euro construction.

The full-access format eliminates the face frame for a cleaner exterior and more accessible interior. Hardware and supports are selected for daily life—not just the showroom.

  • 6-way hingesSoft-close and easy to adjust.
  • Metalbox drawersStreamlined, practical storage.
  • Blum lift systemsStay and fold options for upper cabinets.
  • Adjustable legsMore installation flexibility.
